title: heptapleurum insculptum

The Tongkat Ali is a climbing plant native to Southeast Asia, and it has been used for centuries in traditional medicine to promote overall health and well-being. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties. The Tongkat Ali has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fatigue, stress, and anxiety, and has also been used to enhance physical performance and improve sleep quality.

Note: The plant is also known as Eurycoma longifolia or simply Tongkat Ali.
